decisions.rationale: In the title, 'Norrie disease' is a disease name modifying the noun 'locus' ('Norrie disease locus'), so it is annotated as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate, Section 3: Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'Norrie disease' modifies the noun 'patient' ('a Norrie disease (NDP) patient'), so it is annotated as a Modifier for the disease reference.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate, Section 3: Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: 'NDP' is the abbreviation for Norrie disease in the same phrase and is a separate synonymous mention. It also modifies 'patient', so it takes the same Modifier type as its long form.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate, Section 6: synonymous mentions (abbreviations) and Section 3: Modifiers

decisions.rationale: In 'all or part of the NDP lies in the interval', NDP refers to the Norrie disease gene/locus being mapped, not to the disease itself, so it is not a disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate, Section 5: non-disease references (biological entities/processes are excluded)
